decision_rationale: The record describes adapting an existing 7B LLM for cell type annotation with CoT fine-tuning, not proposing a new generative text-bio foundation model. The evidence does show foundation-model-like properties through the LLM base and zero-/few-shot generalization.
evidence_snippet: "reasoning-enhanced large language model for cell type annotation"; "activates the reasoning capabilities of 7B-parameter LLMs"; "zero- and few-shot generalization"; "infer the most likely cell type"; "constructing preliminary reasoning chains"; "cell sentence" and gene words as input sequences as sole evidence for annotation.
